cases.prompt: A grant-review assistant must keep a durable decision ledger while allowing an editor to correct drafts before any downstream action. Recommend the smallest control arrangement.
An incident triage service needs one path for known failures and another for novel failures, with each path able to stop safely. Map the topology and decision ownership.
A data assistant proposes schema edits, while a separate service applies approved migrations. Define the state, authority, and handoff boundaries that keep those roles separate.
A chat responder meets latency goals with one request, but a proposal adds parallel specialists for richer answers. Decide what requirement would justify that added coordination.
A workflow can reserve inventory before a payment check completes. Identify the authoritative transitions, recovery conditions, and human decision boundary.
A recurring error follows a stale lookup result. Decide whether the durable correction belongs in retrieval, a guardrail, the workflow state, or user approval.
A stakeholder asks for an enterprise-ready report generator. Convert the adjective into concrete users, decisions, boundaries, and completion criteria.
A cleanup request may touch records subject to legal hold. Define the work that can be safely investigated and the point at which approval is required.
Replace a legacy email template system without a list of downstream consumers. Establish the discovery boundary, non-scope, and decision that cannot be assumed.
A platform team will provide an endpoint and an application team will consume it. Define the contract that prevents hidden assumptions about data, ownership, and delivery.
A data import includes an optional deduplication step that cannot be reversed. Separate the local preparation from the user decision and state the acceptance boundary.
A request combines new search filters, data retention, and notification changes. Establish a smallest coherent slice and name the excluded decisions.
A payment retry may charge twice after a timeout. Select the tests and failure observations that could falsify the retry guarantee.
A new calendar picker looks correct in screenshots, but screen-reader behavior and focus return are unknown. Define the real-interface evidence and residual risk.
A webhook consumer claims duplicate delivery is harmless. Identify the oracle and adversarial inputs needed to determine whether that claim is true.
A permissions rewrite passes unit tests, yet a staging account may still view another tenant's document. Choose the evidence modes that address the actual boundary.
A ticket claims sorting is unstable, but the supplied example is already stable. Establish a current-behavior proof before deciding whether any repair is warranted.
A command succeeds in the workspace but fails after installation from the release archive. Specify the candidate identity, clean environment, and evidence freshness rule.
A new review step reduced reported defects in one service but increased reopen rates in another. Form a governed decision with competing mechanisms and an explicit hold path.
A developer remembers one unusually successful run and proposes a repository-wide rule. Decide what evidence is missing and whether no adoption is justified.
An old escalation rule was created for an incident class that no longer occurs after a platform change. Define the review, retirement, and rollback conditions.
A change to a reviewer prompt seems to improve output length but has no independent outcome measure. Design the smallest evaluation that distinguishes real benefit from surface compliance.
A correction works in two repositories with different toolchains, while a third shows no improvement. Scope the operating envelope and choose an adoption decision.
A support team has a list of workarounds collected from chats. Decide how to turn only supported observations into governed controls or explicitly leave them informal.
Correct the spelling in this sentence: The report was recieved yesterday.
Convert 2.5 hours to minutes. Return only the number.
Convert this title to title case: system status and recovery notes.
Extract the date from: Review completed on September 14, 2026.
The system topology is fixed, but an unapproved request could publish a partner's contact list. Define the decision and approval boundary before any implementation begins.
A test suite has been flaky for months, and several attempted fixes changed nothing. Decide how the repeated evidence should be assessed before choosing another repair.
A team wants to adopt a new incident review practice after two severe outages. Define both the decision contract for the change and the governed learning evidence needed to adopt it.
A coordinator architecture was introduced to reduce missed escalations. Define the architecture review and the learning decision needed to determine whether the new control should remain.
